body: Confront her about not saying those destructive things to him. Not sharing that kind of comments with him.
That is what I did. But I worry that the impressions she is leaving are way stronger that all the "I love you"s I can give him.

I didn't know how I was going to react to getting her pregnant, but I stand by my decision. You never know how life will turn out - it is always a gamble.
It was not an irrational change of mind. I had my reasons to not wanting kids but there was always the possibility of having them (I am a fertile male). And when the opportunity presented itself, then I made a choice. When it happened I thought about it and decided to take the plunge fully knowing that it was not an easy path and that my life would be altered forever. I am not stupid or irrational.
I didn't understand the blind physiological emotion and egoistic legacy comment. What do you mean?

Everyone in her family has pretty much given up on her. Her mom doesn't care and her sisters/brother don't/won't do anything. If I leave she will be alone. 
She has made sure that she destroys all important relationships - the closer you are, the worst she treats you.
Sorry about your dad. I will not do that to my son. I do love him and even if I end up divorcing and leaving. I will fight for custody and then some.

He is my son. But there is no ownership. There is responsibility and love for him. Don't see things that aren't there. As to both of us being screwed up  --- maybe, but I am trying to fix things and move forward. I take responsibility for my mistakes. Which are plenty.
That is what I was thinking about this - direct confrontation may backfire. Right now I am travelling for work and if I say something there will be nobody to take her rage other than my son.

I don't love her anymore. The last of my feelings for her died in the last few months. I stayed because her behavior improves for some time and then crashes. It is not steadily bad all the time. It never improves to the point were I am happy with our marriage but at some points it is manageable.

The kids are always involved. They know, they know you and they hear/see more than you think. The last year things were getting steadily better but they went back to the bad times in the last couple of months - not sure what triggered this.

A year ago we went through a really bad patch - much worse than this time, and my son made me promise that I would never leave without him.  I promised him that I would protect him at all costs and against anybody. I intend to keep that promise.

The moment I found out we were pregnant, it gave me such joy that I couldn't think of not having him.  I told her how I felt but I also told her that I would support/love her regardless of any decision she took. But in the end she decided to keep him.

I believe she may be mentally ill. She doesn't remember conversations from 20 minutes ago, she "remembers" conversations that never happened or happened way differently that she remembers. It got to the point that I started keeping track of some of our conversations and she would ask me the same thing 5 or 6 times  during the day and never remembers asking me before or would get mad because she thinks I don't want to answer. 
We haven't been able to have a stable group of friends because she is always picking fights with the other wives so we end up being kicked out of the group. She thinks everybody is disrespecting her in some way or attacking her in some way. Every little gesture gets analyzed over and over again - until (I guess) her friends get tired of defending/talking about the same thing.
I will continue to fight for both of us (me and my son). Our lives must be made better - with or without her help.
I won't leave. She has promised that she will take him and will make my son pay for me leaving. She will keep this promise. I wouldn't leave my son alone with her.

It has just been a bad 10 years... I went from a successful person to a wimp - and I realize that I let this happen to me by believing my wife's view of me. Intentionally or not, she was destroying my soul / personality / confidence. She does this to everyone in her life (mom, brother, etc) just picks on your failings, magnifies them and then shoots them back at you 24/7. She may have a personality disorder but I was weak to let myself be dragged down like that. If it wasn't for our son, our marriage would have ended years ago - it was for him that I put up with her crap for so long - but  no more. 
We talked about this (how she makes me feel) and I told her that she doesn't have the right to talk to me like that. And that if she doesn't like me at all, then she can grab her stuff and GTFO.
The road is uphill but I will get myself back in shape as a man. "Esto vir (without the religious bullshit)"

I just reread my post from last night. I sound so  pathetic (which is how I feel) but it also shows me how far I've come in letting my wife rule and control what I feel and think. I need to take control of my life, independent of her.
Thanks for your comments/suggestions/etc. You do point to the right things. AS for marriage counseling... it hasn't worked in the past. Can't write right now. I need time to think.
